title.zh: 【Kalshi 拟融资约 10 亿美元，估值或达 400 亿美元】
title.en: 【Kalshi 拟融资约 10 亿美元，估值或达 400 亿美元】

current_state.zh: Prediction market platform Kalshi is in advanced talks to raise roughly $1 billion at a valuation of about $40 billion, more than double its $22 billion valuation from a May 2026 round, as it expands beyond sports and election contracts into a multi-asset trading venue and weighs a future IPO.
